claim: A placebo-controlled matched-budget comparison on MBPP+ at 1.5B, 3B, 7B finds blind resampling beats or ties self-repair with execution feedback, and measures repair success only, not any model confidence after the failure.
quoted_support: Blind resampling is the strongest condition below 7B, and remains statistically tied with the best condition at 7B, while consuming 2.5-5.5x fewer tokens; conditioning on the model's own failed attempt costs 6.1 points at 1.5B (p=0.006)

breadth.confidence_families: not present (searched: confiden, calibrat, self-assess, certain; only verbal self-reflection as a repair prompt)
breadth.model_families_and_sizes: 1.5B, 3B, 7B code models on MBPP+ (abstract; Section: setup)
breadth.elicitation_formats: not present as confidence; verbal self-reflection condition only
breadth.causal_intervention: placebo and content-free failure-notice arms for repair success (not for confidence)
